snippet.title: Hexical - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hexical is a retro twin stick action rogue-lite. Install modifications that change how you play. Fight through hordes of viruses to deliver components safely. Make your way through an evolving digital world. Can you defeat all the 3 viral aspects and bring order to the system?

Wishlist Hexical!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283110/Hexical/
